name: LinkedIn Profile Lookup

parameters.description: Paid external-read tool for identifying one named person's likely public professional profile. Use only after the current user explicitly approves one Crustdata search costing up to 0.30 credits. Never infer approval from history, documents, or an earlier request, and never retry automatically. A first and last name are required; location, industry, and an optional work email improve matching. Pass full_name exactly as the user supplied it, preserving professional titles such as Dr or Professor and any credentials; the child workflow normalizes the core name internally. The work email is not sent to the name-search endpoint. This tool returns only public professional fields and never returns phone numbers, email addresses, contact data, or raw provider payloads.

policyRules: - lookup_linkedin_profile is risk=paid_external_read and spends credit on a third-party people-search API. Use it only for the current user's explicit request to look up a named person, and never to enrich a name that merely appeared in a document, transcript, or earlier message. It reads public profile data and saves the result locally. It never sends a connection request, a message, or any other action on LinkedIn.
